title.narrative: Strengthen DOTS Strategy within the Framework of the New Strategy: Stop TB - Guatemala (01-Jul-2019-30-Jun-2022)

description.narrative: Guatemala, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health and Social Assistance of the Republic of Guatemala (MSPAS)This program has the following goals: To reduce the prevalence, incidence, mortality and human suffering due to tuberculosis in the country, strengthening comprehensive and integrated care services for promotion, prevention and care, with a person, family and community centered approach. The objectives of this program are: Strengthen early detection, diagnosis and treatment of drug-sensitive TB, especially in high-risk groups.. Strengthen early detection, diagnosis and treatment of DR-TB, especially in high-risk groups.. Reduce the burden of TB for PLHIV and HIV on people affected by TB. Strengthen the commitment of communities, civil society organizations and all public and private health care providers.. Strengthen the system for information and notification of cases of TB and vital records (mortality due to TB).

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for GTM-T-MSPASP02
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for GTM-T-MSPASP02
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among key affected populations/ high risk groups (other than prisoners)
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among prisoners
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of children <5 in contact with TB patients who began isonizide preventive therapy
Percentage of people living with HIV newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of TB patients with DST result for at least Rifampicin among the total number of notified (new and retreatment) cases in the same year
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Outcome indicators targets and results for GTM-T-MSPASP02
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
